hero.headline: Make Better Farming Decisions with Kissan Saathi
hero.supporting: Check mandi prices, compare markets, understand historical price trends, track farm expenses, monitor weather and get AI-powered agricultural assistance — all in one place.
hero.imgAlt: Indian farmer in green wheat field checking market intelligence on smartphone

features.title: Everything You Need to Make Smarter Farm Decisions
features.subtitle: Built specifically for Indian farmers to bring transparency, clarity, and actionable intelligence to every crop cycle.
features.liveMarketDesc: Get the latest available mandi prices from verified government market data.
features.nearbyDesc: Find nearby markets and compare prices and distance.
features.historicalDesc: Understand how crop prices have changed across states and months.
features.predictionDesc: Get model-based price estimates when sufficient historical data is available.
features.sellDecisionDesc: Compare current prices, historical patterns and available forecasts to support your selling decision.
features.expensesDesc: Track farm costs, production, revenue and profit/loss.
features.weatherDesc: Check current weather, forecast and simple agricultural weather alerts.
features.assistantDesc: Ask questions in English, Hindi or Hinglish and get answers based on available Kissan Saathi data.

marketSection.title: Know Your Market Before You Sell
marketSection.text: Farmers often need to compare prices across markets before deciding where and when to sell. Kissan Saathi brings market information together so you can make a more informed decision.
marketSection.disclaimer: Prices sourced from official Agmarknet wholesale data. Actual auction prices depend on quality, moisture, and local market arrivals.

historicalSection.title: Look Beyond Today's Price
historicalSection.text: Kissan Saathi uses historical market data to help you understand price patterns across months and states.
historicalSection.volatilityVal: Identifies arrival surges and lean supply periods
historicalSection.disclaimer: Historical patterns do not guarantee future prices.

expensesSection.title: Know What Your Farm Really Costs
expensesSection.text: Track crop-wise expenses across seeds, fertilizers, labour, machinery, and transport to calculate your exact cost per quintal and break-even price.
expensesSection.note: Private ledger protected by secure farmer login. We never share your farm financial records.

weatherSection.title: Plan Around the Weather
weatherSection.text: Check current weather, upcoming forecasts and simple agricultural weather alerts for your location before spraying, irrigating, or harvesting.
weatherSection.alertsVal: Timely warnings for rain, heatwaves, and gusty winds
weatherSection.note: Verified meteorological observations from OpenWeather. We never fabricate weather conditions.

aiSection.title: Ask Kissan Saathi
aiSection.text: Get instant answers to your farming and market questions. Our AI assistant analyzes verified market data, weather reports, and farm records to give practical agricultural guidance.
aiSection.q5: "How much did I spend on my farm?"
aiSection.transparencyNote: Ask in English, Hindi, or Hinglish. AI answers are strictly grounded in verified Kissan Saathi data, not fabricated AI guesses.

multilingual.title: Your Language. Your Information.
multilingual.text: Kissan Saathi is designed to make agricultural information easier to understand for every farmer across India.

howItWorks.title: How Kissan Saathi Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to make confident agricultural decisions.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select your commodity, district, and nearest mandi or let the app detect your agricultural hub.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Review official APMC auction rates, 10-year historical trends, local weather alerts, and input costs.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Decide whether to sell now, transport to a better-paying market, or hold for optimal returns.

whyUs.title: Why Farmers Can Use Kissan Saathi
whyUs.subtitle: Built on honest principles and transparent data, without unsupported promises.
whyUs.p1: Verified market data sources directly from official Agmarknet wholesale auctions
whyUs.p2: Historical price intelligence spanning 10 years of market benchmarks
whyUs.p3: Location-based market comparison factoring in distance and modal rates
whyUs.p4: Crop-specific farm expense tracking to identify true break-even points
whyUs.p5: Real-time weather reports and actionable farming advisories
whyUs.p6: AI-powered decision support grounded strictly in verified agricultural records
whyUs.p7: Full English, Hindi, and Marathi multilingual support accessible on mobile phones
whyUs.noFakeClaims: Notice: Kissan Saathi does not guarantee future crop yields, market rates, or profits. Market prices fluctuate based on real supply and demand.

transparency.title: Built Around Real Information
transparency.subtitle: We clearly separate verified primary data sources from AI-assisted interpretations.
transparency.dataSourceDesc: Government mandi records via Data.gov.in (Agmarknet), real-time weather from OpenWeather, and your own private farm expense records.
transparency.aiExplDesc: AI does not generate or guess market or weather figures. It summarizes and translates verified figures into plain, farmer-friendly advice.

finalCta.title: Start Making More Informed Farm Decisions
finalCta.text: Explore market prices, understand your farm economics and stay informed about weather — with Kissan Saathi.
